# Issue

Currently, the warning presented in the VRChat SDK indicates that Audio Sources *without* a VRC Spatial Audio Source is *deprecated*, and provides an "Auto Fix" to add them to the sources.

This warning, from a user facing perspective, **is incorrect**, as features that are deprecated from a user-facing standpoint should not be used for new projects, and should only be used for existing projects where functionality would be diminished.

**Per Phasedragon** ([A](https://discord.com/channels/189511567539306508/361741445352259584/1111805083462684793), [B](https://discord.com/channels/189511567539306508/361741445352259584/1111806214452564028)), VRC Spatial Audio Source is an *optional* component, and audio sources *in worlds* without the component are currently a supported configuration.

# Resolution

Rephrase VRC World SDK warning for Audio Sources without VRC Spatial Audio Source:

- 3D Audio: *"3D audio sources without a VRC Spatial Audio Source component have been found. For more accurate audio spatialization, it is recommended to add a "VRC_SpatialAudioSource" component."*

- 2D Audio: *"2D audio sources without a VRC Spatial Audio Source component have been found. For more accurate audio curves, it is recommended to add a "VRC_SpatialAudioSource" component with spatialization disabled."*
title: [Worlds] Warning incorrect, should be amended for VRC Spatial Audio Source
